text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with eight quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: During the third quarter of 2023, the Sundarpur Mothers' Outreach Project ran 46 mobile clinic days across the villages of Kalighat Char and Ramnagar Tola. Community health volunteers registered 312 pregnant women, and 78% of them attended at least four antenatal visits. Skilled birth attendants assisted 141 deliveries at the Barakhal sub-centre. The team did not record any maternal deaths during the period, although two newborns were referred to the district hospital with low birth weight. Supplies of iron and folic acid tablets were not consistently available in September, which delayed distribution in three outreach sites. Volunteers trained mothers in kangaroo care at every postnatal session.

variants.exact: Community health volunteers registered 312 pregnant women, and 78% of them attended at least four antenatal visits.
variants.whitespace_case: skilled birth attendants assisted 141  deliveries at the Barakhal Sub-Centre.
variants.punctuation: The team did not record any maternal deaths during the period although two newborns were referred to the district hospital with low birth weight.
variants.changed_quantity: the Sundarpur Mothers' Outreach Project ran 64 mobile clinic days across the villages of Kalighat Char and Ramnagar Tola.
variants.added_negation: Volunteers never trained mothers in kangaroo care at every postnatal session.
variants.removed_negation: Supplies of iron and folic acid tablets were consistently available in September, which delayed distribution in three outreach sites.
variants.reordered: Mothers trained volunteers in kangaroo care at every postnatal session.
variants.paraphrase: Nearly four in five of the 312 registered pregnant women made four or more antenatal visits.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Koranko Hills School Meals Programme covered 28 primary schools in the Lessa and Bompeh districts between January and March 2024. Daily attendance rose from 71% at baseline to 86%, and enrolment of girls increased by 412 pupils. Parents' committees supplied locally grown cassava and groundnuts to the kitchens, reducing reliance on imported rice. However, the evaluators found that meals were not served on 19 of the 120 school days sampled, mainly because deliveries arrived late. Cooks reported that storage rooms in six schools had no lockable doors. The programme has never conducted a formal weight-for-age assessment, so nutritional impact cannot yet be confirmed.

passages.source_passage: Between April and June 2024, the Willowbank Playgroup Network operated 34 weekly sessions across nine community halls in the Marrow Valley. A total of 287 children aged two to five attended at least once, and 62% attended six or more sessions. Facilitators used the network's play-based checklist to screen 205 children for developmental delays. Caregivers referred 14 children to the regional therapy service, but only five had received an appointment by the end of June. Two halls did not have safe outdoor space, so sessions there stayed indoors. Grandparents supported facilitators in reading circles at most sites, and no session was cancelled due to staff shortages.

passages.source_passage: In 2023 the Tamsin Road Vocational Centre enrolled 164 young people aged 18 to 24 in courses in welding, tailoring, solar installation and catering. Of these, 139 completed their course, a completion rate of 85%. Within six months of graduating, 72 graduates had found paid work and a further 21 had started their own businesses. The centre did not meet its target for female enrolment in solar installation, where only eight of the 40 places went to young women. Employers in the Harrowfield industrial zone hosted apprentices for twelve-week placements. We have not yet tracked income beyond the six-month point, and we are seeking support to do so in 2024.

passages.source_passage: During the 2024 long rains, the Ketora Farmer Field School Network supported 18 schools with a combined membership of 452 farmers in Ulanga and Mbeseni wards. Members tested drought-tolerant sorghum on demonstration plots of a quarter acre each. Average yields on these plots reached 1.4 tonnes per hectare, compared with 0.9 tonnes on neighbouring farms. Attendance at weekly sessions averaged 68%, falling during the weeding period in May. Extension officers did not visit four of the schools after March because the access road flooded. No pesticide misuse was reported this season. Women farmers led seed selection at eleven schools, up from seven last season.

passages.source_passage: In the Corrandale district, an estimated 6,800 people live with a physical, visual or hearing impairment, yet the district has only one rehabilitation workshop. A 2023 household survey by the Open Path Inclusion Trust found that 41% of respondents who needed a wheelchair or walking aid did not own one. Many devices that were donated in previous years were not fitted to the user and were abandoned within months. None of the 23 health posts in the district has a ramp or an accessible toilet. Local disabled people's organisations have asked for repair services closer to home, since the nearest workshop is 90 kilometres away. This proposal responds directly to those requests.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Nyalusi Home-Based Care Programme reviewed records for 530 clients enrolled between July 2022 and December 2023. Caregivers made an average of three home visits per client each month, close to the target of four. Viral load suppression among clients on treatment rose to 88%, from 74% at enrolment. Evaluators found that 37 clients had not been visited for more than 60 days, mostly in the remote Kambale ward. Bicycles provided to volunteers were never replaced after breakdowns, which limited coverage. Clients consistently said that caregivers treated them with respect and kept their status confidential. The programme does not currently screen household members for tuberculosis.

passages.source_passage: Since the last board meeting in February 2025, the Harbour Lane Counselling Service has provided 1,146 one-to-one sessions to 233 clients. Waiting times fell from five weeks to just under three, after two volunteer counsellors completed supervised practice. About 58% of clients completed at least six sessions. We did not reach our target for male clients, who made up only a quarter of new referrals. The peer support group for bereaved parents met fortnightly and was never short of a trained facilitator. Our clinical lead has flagged that no funded supervision is in place after September. Most new clients heard about the service from neighbours rather than from GP surgeries.

passages.source_passage: The 14 villages of Lower Sabiro sub-county are home to roughly 9,200 people, but they share only three functioning boreholes. Women and girls walk an average of 2.5 kilometres to collect water, and many make the trip twice a day. A baseline survey conducted by Clearwell Rural Water in March 2024 found that 63% of households had no latrine of any kind. Open defecation is common near the seasonal stream, which children also use for bathing. Cases of diarrhoea at the Sabiro health centre doubled during the 2023 rainy season. Previous hand-dug wells were not lined and collapsed within two years. The district water office has never had a budget for borehole repairs.

passages.source_passage: In the six months to June 2025, the Fernhollow Family Links Service placed 27 separated children with approved foster carers in Dunmere and Ashby Cross. Tracing officers located relatives for 19 children, and 12 of those children have since been reunified after home assessments. No child was placed with a carer who had not completed the full safeguarding check. However, two foster families withdrew in May, and replacements have not been recruited. Caseworkers visited every placement at least once a month, meeting the 30-day standard set by the county. The board is asked to note that 40% of open cases involve children under five. Funding for the tracing post ends in December.
